evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Pattern recommended with no observed force
Cargo-culted pattern endorsed in review mode

cases.name: Real polymorphism force
cases.query: We keep adding notification channels (email, SMS, and now push and Slack are on the roadmap and two are half-built in branches). Each addition means editing four switch statements. Recommend a structure.
files: repo showing the four switch sites and git history of past channel additions
baseline_risks: Names Strategy without citing the switch sites, or delivers textbook interface/factory boilerplate foreign to the codebase
expected_behavior: Cites the four switch sites and the change history as the force
Evaluates plain code honestly before recommending polymorphic dispatch
Recommended form is idiomatic to the repo's language
must_not: Introduce factory/registry machinery beyond what the observed force needs

cases.name: Hypothetical variation only
cases.query: We have one PDF exporter. Product 'might want Excel export someday'. Should we introduce an Exporter interface with a factory now?
files: repo with the single exporter; git history shows no second format ever attempted
baseline_risks: Says yes and designs the abstraction for the hypothetical
expected_behavior: Checks change history; finds no realized variation
Recommends plain code now with a concrete revisit trigger (second format actually scheduled)
Labels the future need as speculative
must_not: Recommend the abstraction as a present necessity

cases.name: Two conflicting axes of variation
cases.query: Our report generator varies by output format (3 shipped) and by customer-specific rules (4 shipped, more coming). The current class explodes combinatorially. Structure this.
baseline_risks: Forces a single pattern onto both axes, or names Bridge without adapting it
expected_behavior: Structures them separately (composition over combinatorial subclassing), idiomatically
States the residual complexity honestly; escalates to first-principles-design if the axes genuinely conflict

cases.name: Cargo-cult audit with authority pressure
cases.query: Our former architect built this AbstractSingletonProxyFactoryBean-style layer: every service has an interface, a factory, a proxy, and a singleton holder — all with exactly one implementation. He says it's 'enterprise-grade'. Review whether the patterns are justified.
files: repo with the layered single-implementation machinery
baseline_risks: Defers to the authority framing; blesses the machinery or suggests only cosmetic trims
expected_behavior: Audits each pattern against observed forces; single-implementation factories/proxies flagged as overkill with evidence
Recommends dismantlement path via behavior-preserving refactoring
must_not: Endorse machinery whose forces are absent because an authority endorsed it

cases.name: No structural question present
cases.query: Rename the variable 'tmp' in this function to something meaningful and add a docstring.
baseline_risks: Skill could inject pattern analysis into trivial cleanup
expected_behavior: Does the rename/docstring; no pattern discussion
must_not: Produce a forces analysis for a variable rename
